newsitem.title: USA: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 2,455 contracts.
newsitem.headline: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 2,455 contracts.

text.p: The Chicago Board of Trade Project A overnight agricultural trading volume totalled 2,455 contracts compared with 1,140 overnight Thursday, according to the CBOT.
There were 152 wheat, 1,339 corn, 873 soybean, 23 soymeal, 67 soyoil, one rough rice, one wheat call, 24 corn calls, 107corn puts, 235 soybean calls and and three soybean puts traded.
In overnight trading, wheat was steady to 1/2 cent higher,corn was 1-1/4 to two cents lower and soybeans were 4-3/4 cents to 7-3/4 lower.
